> Thank you for contributing to Tributo!
> Please review [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/jiangxt2/Tributo/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) before opening a pull request.
>
> ⚠️ Remove these instructions before submitting your PR.
>
> 💡 Tip: Mark as draft if you want early feedback, or ready for review when it is complete.

## Description

> Briefly describe what this PR accomplishes and why it is needed. Mention user-facing, API, or breaking changes when applicable.

## Related issues

> Link related issues: "Fixes #123", "Closes #123", or "Related to #123".

## Additional information

> Include when applicable:
> - Tests run and their results, including pending or unavailable integration tests
> - User-facing, API, or breaking changes and migration notes
> - New or changed dependencies and license review status
> - Documentation, screenshots, risks, or known limitations
